A small, open-source take on TinyShield, built for Windows.

This release includes app-grouped TCP/UDP monitoring, IPv4/IPv6 destinations, app-scoped domain/IP blocks, Block and Allow Lists, three connection modes, a live destination map, and offline GeoIP data.

Download the Windows x64 ZIP, extract the entire archive, and run `EShield.exe`. The .NET runtime is included. Windows administrator approval is required. WebView2 Runtime is required for the map.

Documentation screenshots contain fictional example data only. See the README for the feature tour, privacy details, build instructions, and current limitations, including shared-IP domain blocking and retry-after-approval behavior.

Source: MIT. DB-IP Lite data: CC BY 4.0, attributed to DB-IP. See the included third-party notices.
